decisive_items: pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles
response.rationale: The germline FH pathogenic variant with global loss of FH expression in a smooth-muscle tumor is diagnostic of HLRCC syndrome. The pelvic spindle-cell tumor is a manifestation of the syndrome, while the breast nodules are incidental and not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Only explains the incidental breast fibroadenomas and does not account for the pelvic mass, FH loss, or FH mutation.
Describes the smooth-muscle tumor phenotype but omits the defining germline FH mutation and FH loss, which establish HLRCC syndrome.
